coordinates_note: base_sha is the branch tip the capture ran on (Task 4 BASE); merge_sha is the upstream merge commit; merge_base_ours_theirs is git merge-base upstream/main 518d793f (the pre-merge fork tip), while merge_base_upstream_main_head is upstream/main itself because the merge commit made it an ancestor of HEAD
window_note: the three convertible symbols use this window; the refusal symbol uses its own window, recorded per symbol - its last bar is an ex-date, which is what makes production refuse it
additive_source_ruling: Task 3 probe @7fb214aa: eastmoney push2his stock_zh_a_hist unreachable in the ambient environment (fqt=1 0/12, fqt=0 1/11, ProxyError <- RemoteDisconnected in 0.2-0.4s) while Sina stock_zh_a_daily(adjust='') and stock_zh_a_hfq_factor were stable, so the additive frame is synthesized from the Sina factor steps instead of served by a vendor
volume_units: lots (Sina shares / 100, as akshare's a_share loader serves them)

columns.hfq: trade_date,adj_factor, one row per bar in the window (Sina hfq-factor forward-filled)
columns.qfq: trade_date,open,high,low,close,volume (additive levels synthesized from the factor steps)

how_to_load: pd.read_csv(path, parse_dates=["trade_date"]).set_index("trade_date") for raw/qfq; the hfq frame keeps trade_date as a column, which is the (trade_date, adj_factor) shape cn_adjust.apply_qfq expects
dtype_notes: trade_date is datetime64 on both sides here; Sina's raw daily frame carries a date object and its factor table a datetime64, so both were normalized through the loader before writing

Sina's published hfq-factor table is reversed, string-typed, always 33 rows (window params ignored) and carries a 1900-01-01 sentinel row; loader._sina_factor sorts, casts and forward-fills it onto the window, which is what adj_factor holds here
Sina's adj_factor is a rising cumulative multiplier; brief Step 3's helper detects downward steps, so it is fed the exact divisor 1/adj_factor (g_next/g_prev == f_prev/f_next)
reading_notes: offset_distinct is the exact-float count of qfq.close - raw.close (brief Step 1's formula) and counts last-ulp cancellation noise, so it is above plateau_spans (the 1e-6 grouped plateau count); the on-disk pair is offset_distinct_on_disk / plateau_spans_on_disk. Assert plateaus, not exact float counts - the CSV text round trip moves the first number, not the second
pandas' default read_csv float parser is not bit-exact (csv_max_abs_gap_vs_capture is 1e-15 to 1e-13 on the levels); pass float_precision='round_trip' when the bits must match the capture
qfq.volume equals raw.volume by design: an additive vendor frame does not move volume, and it is the converter that divides it by the cumulative ratio
no symbol here is a 送转 window: on the derived path a bonus issue would be re-encoded as a cash plateau, so the converter's price-drift refusal signature cannot appear (see derived_path_limitation)

provenance.eastmoney_vendor_path: not used - unreachable in this environment, see additive_source_ruling

derived_path_limitation: the additive frames in this directory are re-encoded from the same Sina factor table the multiplicative path uses, so these fixtures check that two encodings of one corporate-action history agree (consistency reconciliation); they do NOT independently prove either encoding, and they hold no real refusal sample of the 送转 kind
